# The address rule (spec section 5), one case a line, read by the bash, node and Swift tests alike.
#   allow <address>    the engine, writer.mjs and the app all accept it
#   refuse <address>   all three refuse it, before it reaches security, node or the install record
# The address is the rest of the line after the first space, as written, except four escapes:
# \n a newline, \r a carriage return, \t a tab, \\ one backslash. Lines starting with # and empty
# lines are not cases. An address of more than 2048 characters is refused; the suites test that.
allow https://api.anthropic.com
allow https://api.anthropic.com/
allow https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
allow https://my-gateway.example.co.uk:8443/openai/v1
allow https://h.example/v1
allow https://a.example:1/x
allow https://a.example:65535/x
allow https://localhost:8443/v1
allow https://bridge
allow https://xn--bcher-kva.example/v1
allow https://127.0.0.1.evil.example/v1
allow https://example.com/path/with-dash_and.dot~tilde/
allow https://example.com/v1/%7Euser
allow https://example.com/v1/../../x
allow https://example.com/a;b=c,d!$&()*+:e
allow https://a.0xg
allow https://0xg.example/v1
allow https://[2001:db8::1]/v1
allow https://[::1]/v1
allow https://[2001:db8::1]:8443
allow https://[2001:0:0:1::1]/
allow https://[1:0:2:3:4:5:6:7]/
allow https://[1::]/
allow https://[::]/
allow http://127.0.0.1
allow http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
allow http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/
allow http://localhost:1234/v1
allow http://localhost
allow http://[::1]:8080/v1
allow http://[::1]
# the scheme: lower-case https:// or http:// only
refuse HTTPS://api.anthropic.com
refuse Https://api.anthropic.com
refuse ftp://example.com
refuse https:/example.com
refuse https//example.com
refuse example.com
refuse //example.com
refuse https://
refuse http://
refuse https:///v1
refuse  https://api.anthropic.com
# http for the three local hosts only, exactly
refuse http://example.com
refuse http://127.0.0.1.evil.example
refuse http://127.0.0.1.evil.example:11434/v1
refuse http://localhost.evil.example
refuse http://127.0.0.2:11434
refuse http://0.0.0.0:11434
refuse http://192.168.1.10:1234/v1
refuse http://[::2]:80
refuse http://[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]:80
refuse http://LOCALHOST:11434
refuse http://Localhost
refuse http://localhost.
refuse http://localhost.:11434
refuse http://localhost.:11434/v1
refuse http://127.0.0.1.
# https for a DNS name (lower case) or a bracketed IPv6 literal, never an IPv4 literal
refuse https://1.2.3.4/v1
refuse https://127.0.0.1:8443
# a last label of 0x and hex digits (0x alone included) is a number to the URL parser
refuse https://0x7f000001
refuse https://0x7f000001/v1
refuse https://0xc0a80001:8443/v1
refuse https://127.0.0.0x1/v1
refuse https://0x7f.0.0.0x1
refuse https://1.2.3.0xa
refuse https://0x
refuse https://1.0x
refuse https://a.0x
refuse https://a.0xff/v1
refuse https://API.anthropic.com
refuse https://-example.com
refuse https://example-.com
refuse https://example..com
refuse https://.example.com
refuse https://example.com.
refuse https://exa_mple.com
refuse https://exämple.com
refuse https://exa mple.com
refuse https://[::1
refuse https://[::1]x/v1
refuse https://[fe80::1%25en0]/v1
refuse https://[:::1]/
refuse https://[1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8:9]/
refuse https://[1:2:3:4:5:6:7]/
refuse https://[12345::1]/
refuse https://[::g]/
refuse https://[::FFFF]/
refuse https://[1::2::3]/
refuse https://[::1.2.3.4]/
# IPv6 only as the URL parser writes it: no leading zero, the first longest run of zeros as ::
refuse https://[2001:db8:0:0:0:0:0:1]:8443
refuse https://[2001:db8::01]/
refuse https://[2001::1:0:0:0:1]/
refuse https://[::0:1]/
refuse https://[1::2:3:4:5:6:7]/
refuse https://[0::1]/
# the port: 1 to 65535, digits only, no leading zero
refuse https://example.com:0
refuse https://example.com:65536
refuse https://example.com:
refuse https://example.com:080
refuse https://example.com:8a
refuse https://example.com:-1
refuse https://example.com:443:443
# no user information, query, fragment, space, quote, backslash or control character
refuse https://user@example.com
refuse https://user:pass@example.com/v1
refuse https://example.com@evil.example
refuse https://example.com/v1@x
refuse https://example.com/v1?x=1
refuse https://example.com/v1?
refuse https://example.com/v1#frag
refuse https://example.com/a b
refuse https://example.com/a"b
refuse https://example.com/a'b
refuse https://example.com/a`b
refuse https://example.com/a\\b
refuse https://example.com\\@evil.example
refuse https://h.example/v1\n/tmp/x
refuse https://h.example\n
refuse https://h.example/v1\r
refuse https://h.example/v1\t
refuse https://example.com/<script>
refuse https://example.com/a{b}
refuse https://example.com/a|b
refuse https://example.com/a^b
refuse https://example.com/a[b]
refuse https://example.com/é
